speaker: Flo
text: The son and grandson of noted opera singers, Mei began studying Peking Opera at the age of 8 and made his stage debut at 10, playing a weaving girl. Thereafter he played mostly female roles, becoming especially well-known for his portrayal in The Heavenly Maid Scatters Blossoms. At the age of 13 he joined the Xiliancheng Theatrical Company and, through performances in Shanghai and elsewhere, acquired a national reputation. His style of dance, singing, etc. won such acclaim over the years that it came to be known as the “Mei School”.
